WHO WE ARE

Data protection that
works in your systems.

PT PatuhData Solusi Nusantara is a Jakarta-based company focused on one thing: protecting the data medium enterprises depend on. We keep personal data compliant with UU PDP, and critical systems recoverable when something goes wrong.

Indonesia’s Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) asks every organization to show how personal data is governed, secured, and handled when something goes wrong. Most organizations do not need another policy document. They need someone who can turn requirements into working controls and backups that are proven to restore, and keep them working.

Our team comes from software engineering and IT operations, so we approach both the way engineers do: by changing how systems actually work, and testing that they do.

Our mission

To make data protection practical, accountable, and provable for medium enterprises in Indonesia.

Our vision

Organizations in Indonesia that customers can trust with their data, and that stay resilient when disruption happens.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Your questions,
answered plainly.

Common questions about UU PDP, backup, and recovery from medium enterprises in Indonesia.

What is UU PDP?

UU PDP is Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection, Indonesia’s comprehensive personal data protection law. It applies to organizations that process personal data in Indonesia, and to processing outside Indonesia that has legal effect in Indonesia or on Indonesian citizens abroad.

Is UU PDP already in force?

Yes. The law was enacted on 17 October 2022 with a two-year transition period that ended on 17 October 2024. Organizations are expected to have their processing aligned with the law now.

What happens if an organization does not comply?

The law provides administrative sanctions, including written warnings, temporary suspension of processing, deletion of personal data, and fines of up to 2% of annual revenue. It also sets criminal penalties for certain unlawful acts. Loss of customer and partner trust is often the more immediate cost.

Does my organization need a data protection officer (DPO)?

UU PDP requires a DPO in certain cases, such as processing for public services, core activities that involve large-scale systematic monitoring, or large-scale processing of specific personal data. We help you assess whether the requirement applies and support the person you appoint.

Where should we start?

With an assessment in the area that worries you most: a UU PDP Readiness Assessment for compliance, or a Backup & Recovery Assessment with a live restore test. Each ends with a prioritized roadmap.

How often do you test restores?

Managed Backup & Recovery includes scheduled restore tests in an isolated environment, with the results in your monthly report. Critical systems are fully restored at least once a quarter.

Can you support our branches and factories?

Yes. Branch offices, factories, and warehouses can be backed up to a central location, with an offsite copy kept in Indonesia.

Can you work with our IT team or development vendor?

Yes. We work alongside your IT team or vendor to build consent, data-subject requests, retention, access control, and audit trails into your applications, ERP, and infrastructure.

Do you provide legal advice?

No. PatuhData provides implementation, engineering, and operational support. Where a formal legal interpretation is needed, we work alongside your legal counsel or a qualified law firm.
